  
\# Family Tree Project

\#\# Project Overview

In this project, I have created a three-generational family tree  
using structures and pointers in C.

It stores information about seven family members and connects  
them using pointers to show their relationships.

\#\# Implementation

\- I used a Person structure to store the name, age, father, and mother of each person.  
\- I used malloc() to allocate memory dynamically for each family member.  
\- I used pointers to connect family members and establish their relationships.  
\- I used functions to take input from the user and display family relationships.  
\- I used free() to free the dynamically allocated memory after the program ended.

\#\# Compilation and Execution

To compile and get output from the program, I used the following command:

\`\`\`bash  
gcc family\_tree.c  
./a.out
